input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

Windows-generated CSV exports often use CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings instead of LF (`\n`). When `text.split("\n")` splits a CRLF file, every line retains a trailing carriage return (`\r`), which causes `splitFields` to include `\r` in the last field of every row, making `fields.length` mismatched with `header.length` and triggering `errors.rowShape`.
